## Hook
"Which AI is best?" is the wrong question.

## Reel script (28s), 1080×1920, muted-first
| Time | Visual | On-screen text | Voiceover |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0-3s | Black screen, white text, no logo | "Which AI is best?" is the wrong question. | Which AI is best? Wrong question. |
| 3-9s | Screen recording: /compare index, slow scroll | Best at what? | Ask: best at what? Writing, coding, long documents, research? |
| 9-19s | Open one head-to-head page. Highlight pricing, models, platforms, trade-offs rows | 357 head-to-head comparisons | AI Hub has 357 side-by-side comparisons: pricing, models, platforms and the trade-offs. |
| 19-25s | Two tool names, then a check mark | Pick two. Read the trade-offs. Decide. | Pick two tools, read the trade-offs, decide in minutes. |
| 25-28s | Logo + URL | aihubswiss.org · free | Free at aihubswiss.org. Link in bio. |

**Audio and delivery:** Original voiceover over a quiet instrumental. No TikTok watermark. Captions burned in (muted-first).  
**Cover text:** Wrong question.

Reel checklist: original footage, no third-party watermark, audio on, captions burned in, keywords spoken and on screen, keep key text inside the centre safe zone (clear of the top ~250 px and bottom ~340 px). Consider publishing as a Trial Reel first.

## Caption

```text

AI Hub lists 357 side-by-side comparisons so you can read the trade-offs instead of the marketing.

Send this to whoever on your team is still asking.
```
